what: One hundred machine claims, named before any is decided (the rerun program's phase 4, pre-registered 2026-10-02): each row the bytes that carry the claim pinned by sha256, the pool whose rule chose it, the claimant and the decider expected. NO verdicts live here; the deciding runs write their own ledgers and the register derives its rows from them. A row whose object turns out not to be published is NEEDS DATA and stays; nothing is dropped. The rules per pool are in tools/run-machine-claims.js; the census per pool is in corpus/targets.json.
